common.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like jane@example.com.

setup.title: Set up Solde
setup.intro: Create your household and your admin account. You can invite the others afterwards.
setup.codeHint: Your Solde server printed it in its log when it started, after “setup code:”. With Docker Compose, run: docker compose logs server

errors.codeRequired: Enter the setup code from the server log.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to see your household’s accounts.
login.invitedHint: Invited to a household? Open the link you received to join.

join.title: Join the household
join.intro: Create your account to join. You’ll only see the accounts shared with you.
join.tokenHint: It’s at the end of the link you received, after “token=”.
join.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in.

errors.not_found: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used. Ask for a new one.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Accounts you own or that are shared with you.
accounts.emptyBody: Add an account, then record its transactions by hand.

permissions.readHint: Sees the account and its transactions.

roles.adminHint: Admins can also invite people. They don’t see others’ private accounts.
roles.memberHint: Members see their own accounts and the ones shared with them.

newAccount.title: Add an account
newAccount.subtitle: A manual account: you enter its transactions yourself, and you’re its owner.
newAccount.name: Account name
newAccount.currencyHint: All amounts on this account use it.
newAccount.ibanHint: Helps you recognise the account. Solde never moves money.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the account.

account.readOnlyBody: You can see this account. Ask an owner for edit access to add transactions.
account.notFoundBody: This account doesn’t exist or isn’t shared with you.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.showingLatest: {count, plural, one {Showing the latest transaction.} other {Showing the latest # transactions.}}
transactions.label: Label
transactions.labelHint: What it was, as you want to see it: “Groceries”, “Rent”.

errors.amountInvalid: Enter digits only, with a decimal point or comma if needed.
errors.amountDecimals: {digits, plural, =0 {This currency has no decimals.} one {Use at most # decimal.} other {Use at most # decimals.}}
errors.amountZero: Enter an amount greater than zero.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.subtitle: Who can see and change {account}.
sharing.confirmRevoke: Remove {name}’s access? They won’t see this account any more.
sharing.confirmRevokeSelf: Remove your own access? You won’t see this account any more.
sharing.everyoneHasAccess: Everyone in the household already has access.
sharing.ownersOnlyBody: Ask an owner of this account to change who can see it.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitle: Invite people to your household. Each link works once.
invitations.createdBody: Send this link to the person you invite. It works once and expires on {date}. Solde won’t show it again.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.subtitle: A token lets a script or another app use Solde on your behalf.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameHint: So you recognise it later, like “Laptop”.
tokens.createdBody: Scripts send it in the {header} header. Solde won’t show it again.
tokens.confirmDelete: Delete “{name}”? Scripts using it stop working.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the token.

system.errorIntro: Check that the Solde server is running, then try again.

errors.already_bootstrapped: This Solde is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.currency_mismatch: The amount’s currency must match the account’s.
errors.date_out_of_range: Choose a date between the years 0000 and 9999.
errors.duplicate_iban: You already have an account with this IBAN.
errors.email_taken: A member already uses this email.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_request: Solde couldn’t understand this request. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_setup_code: This setup code is wrong. Copy the latest one from the server log. Each restart prints a new one.
errors.invalid_expiry: Choose an expiry between 1 and 3650 days.
errors.invalid_iban: This IBAN isn’t valid. Check it for typos.
errors.label_too_long: This label is too long. Shorten it.
errors.last_owner: An account needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.name_too_long: This name is too long. Shorten it.
errors.network: Solde can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.not_found: This doesn’t exist or isn’t shared with you.
errors.password_too_short: Use a password of at least 12 characters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.session_required: Sign in with your password to do this.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
